title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree

story.title: Where Two Paths Split
story.text: Two birds want to meet on the lowest branch above both of their fruits. Starting at the top, a scout moves left if both fruits are smaller, right if both are bigger, and stops where they split.
story.goal: Return the value of the lowest common ancestor of p and q.

hints: LeetCode passes TreeNode* p and q; here they are the values, which is all the BST walk needs.
